title: The Concept of Quantum Entanglement
text:
Quantum entanglement is a phenomenon where two or more particles become linked in such a way that they share the same fate, regardless of the physical distance separating them. Measuring a property of one particle instantaneously influences the corresponding properties of all other entangled particles.

The implications of this non-local correlation are profound, challenging classical notions of locality and reality itself. Albert Einstein famously referred to this interconnectedness as "spooky action at a distance," highlighting its counterintuitive nature within standard physics models.

This principle is not merely theoretical; it forms the backbone of emerging quantum technologies such as quantum computing and secure quantum communication systems.
